The organization is going to implement a project named ‘Responsive Emeregency Assistance for Communities in Humanitarian Crisis (REACH) under the Funding support from the United Nations for the Coordination of Humanitarian response (UNOCHA) and Technical Supported by IRC. The project focuses on Through its Child Protection and Protection and Rule of Law (PRoL) program, IRC delivers integrated protection interventions in targeted camps. These include structured curricula such as Psychosocial Support (PSS) and Safe Healing and Learning Spaces (SAFE), community-based child protection programming, adolescent programming, individual protection case management, Individual Protection Assistance (IPA), Cash for Protection, and wider community-based protection activities.. BTS is going to recruit a ‘Asst. Project Officer’ for the mentioned project and the position’s desk office at Ukhiya and Teknaf Camp area in Cox’s Bazar District. Organization Name	: Breaking the Silence (BTS) Project Name	: Responsive Emeregency Assistance for Communities in Humanitarian Crisis (REACH) Job Location : Ukhiya and Teknaf Upazila in Cox’s Bazar District Job Purpose: The Asst. Project Project Officer position is responsible for implemention of the project to ensure effective and timely in line with approved plans, donor requirements, and organisational standards. She/he will execution, and reporting, while guiding the project team, engaging key stakeholders, and ensuring quality delivery of interventions aimed at strengthening community-based child protection at host and camp in Cox’s Bazar District. Job Description / Responsibilities: Child protection program implementation, team management and capacity building: Support to ensure quality child protection program implementation in assigned camp Support and manage the Volunteers who are responsible for organizing and implementing the day-to-day field-level activity. Ensure quality implementation of Adolescent program e.g. formation and strengthen adolescent club, conduct monthly meeting, capacity building, led initiatives, risk mapping. Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly multipurpose based activities plan in coordination and collaboration with his/her line supervisor. Conduct different structured curricula-based sessions e.g. life skills, PSS, positive parenting in camp and also support community volunteers to conduct different sessions, meetings and community outreach sessions as per work plan adhering child safety, active participation. Provide coaching, mentoring, and capacity-building support to volunteers. Ensure children are safe and in a protective environment within MPC center and conduct different session, meetings and engaging in recreational activity. Facilitate “Now I am Stronger” (NIS) sessions using age-appropriate, interactive, and participatory approaches, ensuring adherence to NIS guidelines and standards while promoting children’s psychosocial well-being, resilience, and life skills. Referring to beneficiaries with special needs to respective service providers according to predefined referral pathways with proper documentation.. Supervision and management of child protection services: Supervise and coach volunteers and other relevant actors on the identification, assessment, documentation, case planning, service provision and referral (to relevant services) and follow-up of at-risk children and families. External and internal coordination and representation: Support on and keep up-to-date a map of existing services to which children and families can be referred Build collaborative relationships with organizations and service providers at the field level and support volunteers to ensure effective referrals and collaboration. Work in close collaboration with CBCPCs to strengthen our relationship with the community and to strengthen the referral system. Ensure constant and transparent communication and collaboration with relevant stakeholders, Camp in Charge (CIC), Majhi, including local elected bodies, community members, community leaders, and families. Represent the organization in the community and different platforms & actors related to Child Protection. Accountability, Safeguarding and PSEA:  Assistant Project Officer will ensure accountability, Child Safeguarding and PSEA, donor compliance issues for the REACH project. Assistant Project Officer is responsible for ensuring that safeguarding standards are fully integrated and implemented across all project activities, providing oversight, guidance, and accountability to uphold protection and child protection principles. Others:  Any other duties that may be assigned by the management of organization. Employment Status: Full-time Tenure of Services Contract:  3 (Three) Months probation period. After successful completion of the probation period, based on the performance of the staff and recommendation from the supervisor, the post may be continued till the project’s lifetime.

job_description: Company Overview J M Sinha Agriculture Food Processing Industries Ltd., a sister concern of the renowned ACME Group, is engaged in developing and managing agricultural projects in the northern region of Bangladesh. Located in Setabganj/Bochaganj, Dinajpur, the company aims to establish sustainable, modern, and commercially viable agricultural operations by integrating advanced farming technologies, scientific crop management practices, and efficient resource utilization. To strengthen its agricultural operations and ensure the successful implementation and expansion of its agricultural projects, the company is seeking a highly competent, experienced, and result-oriented professional for the position of  Manager – Agriculture . Job Context The selected candidate will be responsible for the overall planning, development, implementation, supervision, and management of the company`s agricultural projects. The position requires strong technical knowledge of modern agricultural practices, greenhouse farming, crop production, land development, and farm management. The incumbent will lead agricultural operations from land assessment and preparation to crop cultivation, harvesting, and post-harvest management, ensuring optimum productivity, quality, cost efficiency, and sustainable agricultural development. The ideal candidate should possess excellent leadership, operational planning, problem-solving, and project management skills, with the ability to independently manage agricultural projects and achieve organizational objectives within approved budgets and timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Agricultural Project Planning & Management Develop and implement comprehensive agricultural project plans, operational strategies, crop calendars, production schedules, and annual budgets. Plan, supervise, and coordinate all field-level agricultural activities to ensure efficient and timely project execution. Establish production targets, estimate crop yields, and prepare seasonal and annual production forecasts. Ensure successful implementation of agricultural projects within approved budgets, schedules, and quality standards. Identify opportunities for project expansion, productivity improvement, and cost optimization. 2. Land Development & Crop Production Assess and evaluate agricultural land suitability, soil fertility, irrigation facilities, and crop production potential. Develop and execute land preparation, soil improvement, cultivation, and crop management plans. Supervise sowing, planting, fertilization, irrigation, crop maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest operations. Monitor crop growth, plant health, pest and disease conditions, and overall field performance. Ensure optimum crop productivity and quality through scientific and sustainable agricultural practices. 3. Modern Farming & Greenhouse Operations Plan, develop, and supervise greenhouse farming and other modern agricultural cultivation systems. Introduce improved crop varieties, advanced cultivation methods, and innovative agricultural technologies. Apply appropriate agricultural techniques to improve productivity, crop quality, and resource efficiency. Coordinate with agricultural experts and technical consultants to adopt best practices in crop production and management. 4. Budgeting, Resource & Cost Management Prepare annual and seasonal operational budgets, resource requirements, and expenditure forecasts. Ensure effective utilization of agricultural machinery, equipment, seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, irrigation facilities, and other resources. Monitor project expenditures and implement appropriate cost-control measures. Maintain proper records of agricultural inputs, production costs, crop yields, and operational performance. 6. Crop Protection, Quality & Sustainability Implement effective pest and disease management practices, including Integrated Pest Management (IPM). Ensure safe and responsible use of pesticides, fertilizers, and other agricultural inputs. Monitor crop quality and maintain appropriate standards during cultivation, harvesting, and storage. Promote sustainable farming practices, soil health management, efficient irrigation, and environmental protection. Identify agricultural risks and take timely preventive and corrective measures. 7. Stakeholder Coordination & Regulatory Compliance Maintain effective liaison with local agricultural authorities, government agricultural offices, research institutions, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders. Coordinate with agricultural experts and technical service providers for professional guidance and operational improvements. 8. Reporting, Monitoring & Performance Evaluation Prepare and submit daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual agricultural project reports and Management Information System (MIS) reports. Maintain accurate records of crop production, operational expenses, workforce utilization, project progress, and financial performance. Evaluate project performance against approved plans, budgets, and production targets. Identify operational challenges, recommend corrective actions, and report significant issues to management. Perform any other responsibilities assigned by management in connection with agricultural project development and operations.
